$comment: Blocks that stay as drawn art, by decision, with the reason recorded.
Not every box is a diagram waiting to be a flowchart. Mermaid lays a graph
out in ranks, so a figure whose meaning lives in its geometry can come out
saying something the paper does not.
This lives here rather than as a comment in the markdown: an HTML comment
above a fence renders as visible text in MarkdownViewer and duplicates the
block beneath it. Published content should not carry build metadata.
A keep needs a file, a distinctive string from inside the block, and a
reason. Blocks are matched by content, not line number, so they survive

keeps.reason: The Borromean geometry is the content. The three registers are mutually linked, with none mediating the other two. Rendered as a mermaid graph, dagre ranks them into a top-to-bottom chain, which asserts exactly the hierarchy the figure exists to deny. Verified in the browser before deciding.

A verbatim terminal transcript, not a diagram. Section 8 lists it as 'Raw ASCII console output: direct terminal export for CLI workflows' and the prose says it is 'printed exactly as the materialized view returned it'. Redrawing it would falsify that claim, and the bar glyphs are the score decomposition.

A mock-up of the live dashboard, so the visual arrangement is the content: note positions along each instrument line carry the timing, and the bar meters carry the dissonance, health and arrhythmia readings. A node-and-edge graph cannot express either.
